sources.note: 2-bit, 86.7 GB, plus MTP file 3.8 GB, for DwarfStar

parameters_active_b.note: 284B total and 13B activated in the card

runtimes.value: DwarfStar (ds4, Metal-first, own GGUF files, beta, 96 GB+); llama.cpp llama-server with GGUF (ggml-org, unsloth UD-IQ2_M); LM Studio (lmstudio-community GGUF); MLX low-bit builds in mlx-community (2.4bit-mixed, OptiQ-2bit). Ollama: official library has only cloud tags (V4.1 Flash, V4 Pro); local only via community frob/deepseek-v4-flash-0731
runtimes.note: DwarfStar README names V4 Flash and a Flash 0731 checkpoint but fetches its own files with download_model.sh; that antirez/deepseek-v4-gguf is the same source is unverified. Whether the community Ollama tag runs well locally, and whether stock mlx-lm loads the 0731 MLX builds, are unverified. A newer V4.1-Flash-1017 exists on HF (ggml-org, mlx-community, unsloth).

web.scope: V4 Flash released 22.04.2026, checkpoint 0731 on 31.07.2026: comments since 13.05.2026 plus the launch. Hacker News comments only; Reddit and Hugging Face discussions not read.
web.summary: The strongest model that fits on 128 GB according to many Mac users, at the cost of a 2-bit quant and most of the memory. Test it against Qwen3.8-27B.
web.verdict: Leading local model on 128 GB Macs in mid-2026, 14–30 tok/s; barely fits

comments.text: A 128 GB Mac only just fits it ([pornel, 16.06.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48563585)); 128 GB is too little for a good quantisation ([cmrdporcupine, 23.07.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49020516)).

Still produces a malformed tool call from time to time ([kamranjon, 14.07.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48913036)); a lot of fan noise on a MacBook Pro M5 Max ([reverius42, 31.07.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49120467)).
An M5 Max 128 GB Mac Studio owner settled on Qwen models instead ([fzxu22, 05.11.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50385925)).
No vision in the 2-bit text build ([kamranjon, 12.06.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48503585)).
Used as the main model for everything on an M4 Max 128 GB MacBook Pro with DwarfStar ([kamranjon, 12.06.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48503585)).
~24 tok/s generation, ~200 tok/s prefill on an M4 Max 128 GB; better at long tool-calling tasks than GPT-4-class models ([jumploops, 13.06.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48510866)).
Pretty good speed and coding ability on a Mac Studio 128 GB ([davedx, 19.10.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50148812)).

Even at 2-bit, among the best local models one user has benchmarked ([spottedmarley, 14.08.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49298258)); results far better than usual for a 2-bit quantisation ([Catloafdev, 17.09.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49741914)).
